title: Depots found by auth values
description: The depots whose auth values match the request's. The auth values themselves are never returned

matches.description: One match per request item and depot, ordered by index. An item with no depot has no match. An item can match more than one depot, and several items can match the same depot

index.description: the position of the matched item in the request's authValues

depotId.description: the id of the depot whose auth values match the item
